sidebar.title: Sidebar
sidebar.hint: Applies to the sidebar of every cluster.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.systemHint: System follows the light or dark mode of your operating system.
appearance.languageHint: System follows the language of your operating system, or English when Sextant has no translation for it.

window.title: Window
window.closeToTray: Closing the window keeps Sextant in the tray
window.closeToTrayHint: Sextant keeps running in the tray: connections, port forwards, terminals and the MCP server stay open. Its icon in the tray (the menu bar on macOS) shows the window again; “Quit Sextant” in the icon’s menu quits.
window.noTray: No system tray was found, so closing the window quits Sextant. On Linux the tray needs the libayatana-appindicator library and a StatusNotifier/AppIndicator host (on GNOME, the AppIndicator extension) or, in an X11 session, a system tray.

editor.title: Editor
editor.hint: Colors of YAML in the resource editor, the details panel and Helm. Auto uses One Dark in the dark theme and GitHub Light in the light theme.

helm.title: Helm
helm.hint: Installing and changing Helm releases runs the helm command. Viewing releases works without it.
helm.notRunnable: {{path}} is not a working helm binary

kubeconfig.title: Kubeconfig
kubeconfig.hint: Clusters come from KUBECONFIG (or ~/.kube/config) and from the files you add here.

file.label: Settings file
file.backup: The settings file was damaged, so Sextant started with default settings. The old file was copied to {{path}}.
file.unwritable: Changes are not saved: the settings file cannot be read or written. Fix its permissions and restart Sextant.

terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.nodeShellImageHint: Image of the temporary privileged pod behind "Shell" on a node. It needs nsenter (busybox has it); the shell itself is the node's. AI agents never get a node shell.

fonts.monoHint: Terminal, YAML editor, logs and code.
fonts.showAll: Show all fonts, not only monospace
fonts.proportionalHint: Proportional fonts break the terminal's column grid and the alignment of code; pick a monospace font for them.
fonts.failed: The installed fonts could not be read.
fonts.notInstalled: {{family}} is not installed on this computer; the built-in font is used.

accessibility.reduceMotionHint: System follows the reduced-motion setting of your operating system. Reduced motion turns off transitions, animations, smooth scrolling and the blinking terminal cursor.
accessibility.textSizeHint: Text, table rows and controls grow with it; the terminal, logs and the YAML editor follow.
accessibility.terminalScreenReader: Screen reader support in the terminal
accessibility.terminalScreenReaderHint: Lets a screen reader read terminal output. It slows the terminal down, so leave it off unless you use a screen reader.
